This time you notice the spilled blood BEFORE you slip.
Your FuneralManager (TM) software upgrade comes in the mail!
You put headphones on a body and take a picture, you're a riot.
Some kids come by and want to see a body, you charge 'em.
`4You trip over an arm.
You perform a body puppet show to pass the time and crack yourself up.
You win your computer game, Teenage Lawnmower!
`4Yikes! You forgot to pay taxes last month!
At your high school reunion, you find you now make more money than the former captain of the football team!
You find out that your old high school sweetheart has married the captain of the football team.
An old mortuary science professor bequeaths you his favorite skeleton, "Morty".
`$Ever get the feeling you're being `4watched`$?
Some kids dig through your garbage and find your "gag" photographs.
Oh no! One of Deathville Zoo's pythons has escaped. I guess business will be picking up soon.

Local college frat boys rent some of your inventory for pledge week.
Local college frat pledges break into your parlor and steals some inventory.

Cousin Sal, the idiot no one thought would get a job, gets his medical degree from the University of POBox 411 and moves into Deathsville. Nepotism is, for lack of a better word, good.
A major duststorm shuts down Deathsville for awhile. Apparently, even death can take a holiday.
The local bar introduces new 80-proof barley wine. Locals mistake it for regular beer. DWI incidents skyrocket.

entries.title: DEATH WITH DIGNITY
entries.message: 20 percent off Gold Coffins at Di-Mart! For a comfortable eternal lay, come see us today!

entries.title: NEW SPEED LIMIT SPEEDS DEATH
entries.message: Maybe 55 in a residential is bad. "We should've known people can't dodge cars," admits the Department of Transportion.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the DMV.\n\n`$"We heard you give bulk discounts..."
entries.addLog: `7DEATH CARE PROVIDER CHOSEN\n`^The Department of Transportation has issued a statement declaring *HOME* the official location for today's services. *NAME* will be on hand for counseling.

entries.title: MIXED UP VIAGRA MEDICATION IN RETIREMENT HOME
entries.message: "It's like a stabbing ... but different," comments the coroner's office.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Golden Oaks Retirement Home.\n\n`$"We've got some bodies for you..."
entries.addLog: `7FUNERAL HOME CHOSEN\n`^Golden Oaks Retirement Home has announced that *NAME* from *HOME* will be hosting services for the recently departed.

entries.title: A BURGER TO DIE FOR
entries.message: Ecoli outbreak hits Bill's Big Burger leaving many dead or just puking a lot.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe president of Bill's Big Burger walks in.\n\n`$"Let's make a deal..."
entries.addLog: `7BURGER CONTRACT SIGNED\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* has been signed exclusive rights to the Bill's Big Burger  related deaths.  There will be a buffet.

entries.title: ENTIRE SOCCER TEAM KICKS COLLECTIVE BUCKET
entries.message: Plane crash kills 15 people.  Some funeral parlor is going to be in for some big business.
entries.giveRandom: `wA soccer coach brings in 15 dead people - and he wants them all embalmed!
entries.addLog: `7LOCAL PARLOR SCORES\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* will host the funeral and memorial service of the brave 15 soccer players who ended life so tragicially.

entries.title: ZOO ANIMALS ESCAPE, SEEK REVENGE ON HUMANS AND COTTON CANDY
entries.message: "Now their rage is out of the cage," says local australian zookeeper.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe chairman of your local zoo walks in with a black garbage bag.\n\n`$"Please bury this.  ASAP."
entries.addLog: `7AUSTRALIAN ZOOKEEPER MAULED\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* will be hosting services today.

entries.title: THE BIG ONE HITS
entries.message: An earthquake measuring 8.6 on the Richter scale shook things up today.  Families have banded together to locate a death care facility that will offer a package deal.
entries.giveRandom: `wA large truck parks out front and a group of people come inside.\n\n`$"What we really want is one really large grave..."
entries.addLog: `7EARTHQUAKE TRAGEDY HAS BRIGHT SIDE\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* has allowed the victims to purchase one rather large grave together for a discounted per person price.

entries.title: COMPETITION IS FIERCE IN FUNERAL INDUSTRY
entries.message: "There just aren't enough bodies to go around.  Some of these places will die off," admits Mayor.

entries.title: MANY DEAD AFTER PLAYING THEIR ONLINE GAMES TOO LONG
entries.message: "All they wanted was another level, what they got was death," comments Police Commissioner.

entries.title: LOCAL PIZZA COMPANY SCREWS UP BIGTIME
entries.message: "If they didn't eat the pizza in under 30 minutes they would die.  Bad cheese indeed," reports some dude.

entries.title: MAN KILLED BY NEW LASER PRINTER
entries.message: "He thought it was a xerox machine and was trying to photocopy his ass," explains his manager.

entries.title: SNAKEHEAD FISH MENACE STRIKES DEATHSVILLE
entries.message: "At long last, our quiet community has been distrupted by these air-breathing, sword-wielding ninja fish. God help us all," said the mayor at a recent press conference.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the Hospital.\n\n`$"More fish fatalities for you, *NAME*."
entries.addLog: `7*HOME*'S SUCCESS LINKED TO SNAKEHEAD FISH\n`^*NAME* says "God bless those carniverous Asian fish."

entries.title: AREA YOUTH AVOID SUN, FRESH AIR
entries.message: Many of Deathsville's young aren't playing baseball or street hockey these days. Instead, they rush home from school on to their computers to get their daily fix of FUNERAL QUEST. When will the madness end?

entries.title: LEGISLATOR PASSES TAX BREAK FOR MORTICIANS
entries.message: Deathsville's funeral parlors are filled with glee today at the news of the tax break. Said one owner, "They said I was a freak for becoming a mortician. Who's laughing now?"

entries.title: DEAD MAN'S LAST WORDS: "I CAN'T BELIEVE IT WASN'T BUTTER"
entries.message: A mixup at the diary processing plant led to a lethal dose of cleaning fluids entering the butter production unit. Plant Manager George Toole offered his apologies to Deathsville's many affected families. "Come down to the factory and we'll give you new butter."

entries.title: GREEN METEOR SHOWER BRINGS RECORD CROWDS
entries.message: Last night's highly distinctive eerie green meteor shower dazzled area spectators last night. "It was the prettiest thing I ever done seen," said Emma Lou Harrison who awoke this morning totally blind.

entries.title: FREAKY KID SEES "DEAD PEOPLE"
entries.message: Area nerd claims to see "dead people" all around him during his daily routines. "Of course he does, " said his mother. "We run a funeral parlor."

entries.title: AREA POETS, SENSITIVES LANGUOR IN DELIRIUM
entries.message: Medical experts are dumbfounded at the record number of area residents who have taken ill this Hallowmas. Most of those afflicted are artists of some sort. One man, a young poet, has sculped a blasphemous, basalt figurine with a tentacled head and a bloated, rugose body backed with bat-like wings. When questioned, Father Smyth said "this can't be good."

entries.title: THEATRE FIRE KILLS DOZENS
entries.message: The popular theatrical adaptation of the movie "BackDraft" came to deadly conclusion last night in neighboring town Blaine when the special effects got out of control.

entries.title: AREA TEENAGERS UNMASK "ZOMBIE SCARECROW"
entries.message: Before a disbelieving sheriff, four area youths removed the mask of the so-called "Zombie Scarecrow," who turned out to be none other than Old Man Withers. According to one of the young sleuths, Withers "like wanted to frighten the farmers away from the corn field so he could make off with the buried treasure."

entries.title: SOME OF AREA DEAD EVIL, MENACING
entries.message: A local professor's cabin, located in a remote wooded area, was the scene of hair-whitening terror last night as the recording of demon-resurrection passages were unwittingly played aloud by a curious area youth. It was later learned that the professor and his wife had been overcome already by the resuscitated evil when the recordings were  first made. Emergency personnel were unable to reach the cabin, due to a bizzare bridge accident.
entries.giveRandom: `wYour answering machine has the message:\n\n`$Bring the SUV hearse up to the haunted cabin. We got bodies.
entries.addLog: *HOME* discreetly removes the bodies from the haunted cabin, woodshed.

risks.startMessage:
`$A woman walks into the store.

`wWoman: `$"Hello *SIR*, a few days ago you buried my daughter.   She was wearing a giant ruby ring, you didn't happen to take it off and save it for me, did you?"

The ring is on  your desk, it doesn't look like she saw it.
risks.normalMessage: `w*NAME*: `$"Ah yes, the ring.  I was about to phone you.. here it is."\n\n`wWoman: `$"Thank you so much!  This ring meant so much to me."
risks.failMessage: `w*NAME*: `$"I'm so sorry my dear woman, it's buried forever."\n\n`wWoman: `$"Alright, thanks anyway...WHAT THE?? THAT'S HER RING RIGHT THERE!  How 'bout putting it on this finger?"
risks.successMessage: `w*NAME*: `$"I'm so sorry my dear woman, it's buried forever."\n\n`$The woman leaves in tears, the ring is yours!

risks.startMessage: `$You notice a finger poking through the dirt on one of your fresh graves.\n\nIf you re-bury it correctly to the full six feet it will take some time.  Of course, you could just kick some dirt over the top...who would notice?
risks.normalMessage: `$You figure better safe than sorry.  You get the power digger from the garage and things actually go faster than you thought they would.
risks.failMessage: `$You just kick some dirt over the shallow spots.\n\nYou wait and watch through the window awhile.. Uh oh, what is that dog doing... people coming over.. great, now kids are screaming.
risks.successMessage: `$You just kick some dirt over the shallow spots.\n\nYou wait and watch through the window awhile.. nobody seems to notice!

risks.startMessage: `$As you are moving a body downstairs you notice an unused lottery ticket falls out of the corpse's pocket.\n\nThe viewing is in a few minutes, but playing the ticket would only take a second...
risks.normalMessage: `$You carefully put the ticket back in, now is not the time to gamble.
risks.failMessage:
`$You lean the body against the wall and play the ticket... (scroll down)






It lost.  You kick the body in anger...

`4THE CORPSE FALLS DOWN THE STAIRS!  It bounces into the slumber room to the surprise of the family.
risks.successMessage:
`$You lean the body against the wall and play the ticket... (scroll down)






It's a winner!

You put the ticket in your own pocket to cash later.

risks.startMessage: `$As you are preparing the floral arrangement for a service you notice the flowers are red instead of the requested white..\n\nYou know you should order new ones but you also see a bucket of white paint nearby...
risks.normalMessage: `$You order replacement flowers.  Taking shortcuts is not how you want to build your reputation.
risks.failMessage: `$You paint the flowers.\n\nAt the service an old woman smells them and unknowingly leaves a `4bright white mark on her nose`$.  You try to stifle a giggle but fail, everybody starts laughing at woman who is now in tears.
risks.successMessage: `$You paint the flowers.\n\nAt the service an old woman tries to smell one but you shove her away, great work!

risks.startMessage: `$In the middle of an embalming you must visit the restroom.\n\nYou're really in a rush to eat so you can get back to work and finish early.. yet washing your hands is the law, albeit a time-waster.  What do you do?
risks.normalMessage: `$You carefully wash your hands with disinfectant.  Cleanliness is godliness.
risks.failMessage: `$You skip the washing part.\n\nAfter eating you get back to the embalming.  You barely finish removing the small intestines before you `4start feeling really sick`$.. something you ate maybe?
risks.successMessage: `$You skip the washing part.\n\nAfter eating you finish the embalming with time to spare!. You break out your Atari 2600 and play games in the basement for awhile.

risks.startMessage: `$It's true that the good die young. In fact some of your inventory looks so good, it's a right shame to let them go to waste.\n\nWould it really be so wrong to take a few pictures?
risks.normalMessage: `$After thinking more on the matter, you decide to leave pornography to professional perverts.
risks.failMessage: `$As you position the models, `4the corpses begin to fall apart. `$Just as you finish reassembling the bodies, you are discovered by the cleaning lady.\n\nBoy, is this going to hurt business!
risks.successMessage: `$Throwing caution to the wind, you power up your Nikon camera and get busy.\n\nHey, at least you don't have to deal with `4prima-donna back-sassing `$from the models!

risks.startMessage: `$You see a competitor's shiny new hearse parked near your parlor.  No one is looking.
risks.normalMessage: `$Revenge is a dish best served cold. You will await the passing of years until the most perfect opportunity arises. Then you will feed off the bitter tears of your competitor's sorrow.
risks.failMessage: `$Someone spotted you. \n\n`4You have to pay reparations.
risks.successMessage: `$You key the hearse.\n\n`4Pay back's a bitch!

risks.startMessage: `$You happen upon an `5ancient scroll `$in the suit pocket of your most recent client. Its black words instruct you on how to raise the dead.
risks.normalMessage: `$As the scroll disappears into thick, viscous smoke, you feel pride in your victory over the forces of darkness.\n\nThen you realize that there are more scrolls out there...
risks.successMessage: `$After completing an incantation better suited for inhuman tongues, the ground trembles and cracks! `4The dead walk again!\n\n`$Coolio!

risks.startMessage: `$A vaguely familar woman walks in.\n\n`wWoman: `$"Hello *SIR*. I've been watching your parlor carefully and I've seen the blasphemous things you do to save money. You're a horrible, horrible person! I really should report what I've seen to the police, but I may be pursuaded to look the other way ... for a fee."
risks.normalMessage: `$A little hush money never hurt anybody (much). Perhaps it's time to paint the windows black in your funeral home.
risks.failMessage:
`wWoman: `$"Skinflint! You'll regret this!"

You have a feeling the Deathville PD may be dropping by for a chat.

Rats!
risks.successMessage: `w*NAME*: `$"What?! How dare you threaten to ruin my good name with pernacious lies and half-truths! Get out!"\n\nThe woman blanches and runs out of your parlor. I guess you can't kid a kidder.

risks.startMessage: `$As you look at the lonely cemetery that lies in back of your parlor, you think about all the money that's been wasted on headstones no one ever comes to visit. A person could make a tidy sum by recycling some of those headstones. Go for it?
risks.normalMessage: `$Fie on those old mangy headstones. It would be more trouble to move them than they're worth.
risks.failMessage: `$Just as you deracinate the last headstone, you hear a withered, scratchy shriek from behind you. Uh oh.\n\n`4You were caught in the act of cementary vandalism!
risks.successMessage: `$Recycling. It's good for the economy and Mother Earth.\n\nNice going, Slick.
